the growth mechanism of GaAsBi, the influence of Bi on the band structure and the electrical properties, and the synthesis of AlASBi by molecular beam eitaxy.

Bi is an important element in III V semiconductor materials and the Bi incorporation has great influence on the optical and electrical properties.

the Bi concentration in AlAsBi films could reach 2.2 at.% and the Bi incorporation was insensitive to the As/Al flux ratio.
the bandgap of AlAsBi can be tuned from indirect to direct by increasing the Bi concentration.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Bi concentration in GaAsBi can be increased by increasing the Bi flux.
Bi incorporation in AlAs can be achieved at low temperature and high As/Al ratio.
the Bi incorporation in AlAsBi is much lower than that in GaAsBi and the Bi concentration can be increased by decreasing the As/Al flux ratio and by increasing the Bi flux.
